_readme: One entry per place a LEADFUSE application link gets posted. slug = the folder under /apply/ and the value of formsource (the exact link). utm_source follows the naming Sebastian already uses on his bio links (bio_business, bio_personal): place_account, underscores. medium = utm_medium. utm_campaign is always 'apply'. Any utm_* added to a link's URL (?utm_campaign=black-friday) overrides these for that click. Add a row, run build.py, commit. Never rename a slug that has already been posted somewhere.

root.where: leadfuse.co itself (nav, footer, anyone who types /apply)

sources.where: LinkedIn: Sebastian's profile, featured section, DMs
LEADFUSE Training Material (the free Skool room): lesson 4.3, Start Here, pinned post
Skool anywhere else: profile bio, posts in other communities
LEADFUSE VIP (the paid room): upgrades and renewals
YouTube descriptions, pinned comments, end screens
Emails from the App (nurture, follow-up, newsletters)

Vincent Caruso, LEADFUSE partner (paid on every client his link brings): his YouTube descriptions and pinned comments, Instagram stories and bio. Add ?utm_content=<place-video> per placement (yt-1van, ig-story) so we can tell which video or post paid him.

_form_note: D8gcUEt2 is the site's copy of the ads form xPLSrpmn (same questions, scoring and App webhook); its endings redirect to leadfuse.co/apply/book/ and /apply/not-ready/. Keep it in sync with funnel-forms/typeform_site_copy.py.
_aliases_note: Old slugs that went live on Oct 22 2026 before Sebastian picked bio-lf and bio-smf. They forward to the new link, keeping the query. Never delete an alias.
_test_drive_note: apply/test-drive/ is NOT built from template.html. It is the apply.leadfuse.co landing page copied by apply/_src/test_drive.py with the 4-Week Test Drive words swapped in (same design). /apply/free-trial forwards to it.
